title: EPCIS 2.0.1 JSON and JSON-LD source exchange
description: Bounded import, standard query consumption, exact-byte retention, idempotent and conflict-aware re-arrival, and original-byte export of EPCIS 2.0.1 documents, as spec/epcis-interoperability.md defines. A source is validated against the pinned schema and retained with its findings; it is never repaired, coerced or reordered, and importing it never publishes a credential or touches a native token. Not an EPCIS repository, not a capture interface, and not a claim of GS1 conformance.

standards.name: GS1 EPCIS
standards.scope: The JSON and JSON-LD bindings of EPCISDocument and EPCISQueryDocument, the five event types, event identity and error declarations, and the REST query binding's events query, pagination and headers.

standards.name: GS1 Core Business Vocabulary
standards.scope: Business step, disposition, business transaction and source or destination type values as the JSON binding carries them; no other vocabulary is interpreted.

standards.name: GS1 Digital Link URI syntax
standards.scope: The reading of claimed-GS1 identifiers that appear as HTTPS Digital Link URIs; the grammar is applied, never used to rewrite an identifier.

standards.name: JSON Canonicalization Scheme
standards.scope: The canonical form the event-body digest and inline context digests are taken over.

artefacts.notes: Every source document is validated against these exact bytes; a document the schema rejects is retained with failed findings, never repaired.
The one context IRI this profile pins; its digest enters every event-body digest of a document that declares it.
The shape of a named query body; the pull connector expresses its bounded query through the standard parameters and this schema names them.

artefacts.licence: Apache-2.0 as its info block declares
artefacts.notes: Pinned by digest and not carried: the pull connector consumes GET /events with MATCH_anyEPC, eventType, GE_eventTime, LT_eventTime, GE_recordTime, EQ_eventID, perPage and nextPageToken, the Link rel=next header, GS1-EPCIS-Version and GS1-CBV-Version, and GS1-Next-Page-Token-Expires, exactly as this artefact defines them.

inputs.notes: The JSON binding; the document declares its @context.
One page of a standard query result, from a file or from the pull connector.

outputs.format: the exact received bytes, served under the received media type
outputs.notes: Export returns the retained bytes and never a re-serialisation.
Per-event pointers, identities, validation and mapping findings, conflicts and publication references.

dependencies.name: ajv

dependencies.name: ajv-formats

mappingLimits.reason: A context IRI this profile has not pinned is preserved as declared; no claim that depends on its terms can pass.
An event whose type is not one of the five is retained with its pointer and identity and is not interpreted.
Two JSON-LD spellings of one meaning digest differently; equivalence across terms or sources is not promised and never inferred.
A pull bounded by record time cannot discover every retrospective error declaration; completeness is declared per query, never assumed.

unsupported.reason: The XML binding is not read; a source in XML is refused by media type.
No subscription or push delivery; retrieval is a bounded pull or a file import.
This profile imports and retains; it does not operate a capture endpoint or an EPCIS repository.
No import or pull asserts complete history; each result declares its query, cutoff and limits.
An import never issues, updates, transfers or retires a native passport state and never publishes a credential; those are separately authorised operations.
Retrieval of further identifiers requires explicit caller or configured scope; there is no repository crawler.
